calibration_limits.warning: An axle-separation scale tied to1285mm gives only one projected baseline. It does not establish focal length, yaw/pitch, depth, projection type or an orthographic camera. Do not multiply these profile coordinates by the scale to claim tank/seat dimensions.
calibration_limits.source_pixels_have_uncertainty_beyond_re: Cutout/alpha edges, source resampling and different surface depths may bias contours. No numerical camera-error bound has been established.

cross_view_correspondences.relation: Same component feature, different near/far envelope and perspective. Not a reconstructed physical centre.

Opposite-side projected crown; rack occlusion differs.
Corresponding visible junction region, not a shared bolt, cross-section or precisely identified material point.

asymmetry_rules: R00 observes the right-side skins (X negative); R04 observes left-side skins (X positive). They are not mirror photographs with a known shared camera.
The guide baselines differ (527px in R00 and555px in R04). Preserve the recorded camera/guide uncertainty rather than deforming parts until both look identical.
The tank and saddle may have approximately bilateral main forms, but section symmetry is not proved by two non-calibrated side images. Keep lateral controls independently comparable.
Left and right covers are separate components. Their visible red interfaces do not prove common pions, screw positions or depth; no hidden geometry is annotated.
Decal edges, painted highlights and shading bands are not physical silhouette or seams. Manufacturer graphics remain documentary and are not transferred into WEWA textures.

tank_front_mount.next_evidence: Front/underside tank and actual rubber supports with scale; D04/D15 mounting drawings remain related-variant only.

tank_rear_mount.next_evidence: Tank/seat separated or a clear underside photograph with scale.

seat_fixings.next_evidence: Mounted saddle fixings with seat lifted/removed; do not transfer related JV191001 underside dimensions without measurement.

attachment_handoff.rack_frame_visible_heads: Only image observations are supplied. Their function and axes must be confirmed before constraints are added.

next_manufacturer_comparison_protocol: Keep the original raster/hash and these annotations fixed. Display projected candidate overlays at1000x700 with UV origin top-left; log any display crop/scale separately.

Use the shared cockpit axes: tank/seat in the same assembly frame, front toward-Y and up+Z. For an initial side comparison, camera on-X observes right side likeR00, camera on+X observes left side likeR04; yaw/pitch/focal length still require explicit fitting or measurement.

Fit/record camera hypotheses and use the unchanged wheel/handlebar guide anchors first. A convenient orthographic preview is allowed only as a named hypothesis, not as proof that the source is orthographic.
Compare upper shell, seat top, nose seam and lower visible arcs as separate open segments. Do not close contours across cap, rack, cover or steering occlusions.

Check each side independently. Annotated image reading intervals do not include unknown projection error; remaining disagreement may be camera, depth or genuine asymmetry, not automatically a shape defect.
Obtain tank top/front/back/underside and saddle top/underside with a scale before asserting transverse sections, thicknesses, actual mounting datums or physical part dimensions.
No component receives G3/G8 approval from this annotation JSON; no previous component or central datum is moved here.
